parsed.rationale: All three records — `PlaylistSectionHeader` in `PlaylistView.swift`, `TextRowView` in `TextRowView.swift`, and `FittingText` in `InfoDetailView.swift` — are `type-alias-object` kinds within the same `app:iOS` package and share 2 fields according to `shared_field_count: 2`, indicating they alias the same underlying SwiftUI view shape. Because all three live in the same package and carry no restraint markers (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app` all false), consolidating them into a single canonical type alias (retaining the name `FittingText` as the most semantically neutral choice) eliminates the redundancy. The two aliased-away names (`PlaylistSectionHeader`, `TextRowView`) can be replaced at their call sites with the single shared alias, or kept as `typealias PlaylistSectionHeader = FittingText` shims if call-site churn is a concern.
